* Élaborer des stratégies et des feuilles de route pour cerner les risques et favoriser l'assainissement, en s'harmonisant avec les objectifs opérationnels.
* Examiner la conception et fournir des conseils de sécurité pour améliorer la sécurité des environnements ICS/OT des centres de données et des plateformes de gestion.

jobs.description:
Google Zürich, Switzerland

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience with Computer Vision (image classification and processing, object detection, visual search), video generation, or signal processing; and experience designing Computer Vision systems.
* 3 years of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).
* Publication record in AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* Experience working in an industry or academic research lab, focusing on multiple aspects of the "research to product" pipeline, particularly model optimization and efficiency improvements.
* Familiarity with generative AI techniques, such as image diffusion models, and their application to visual enhancement.
* Strong background in 3D computer vision and deep learning, with specific, proven expertise in Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), and 3D scene reconstruction.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will be part of the XR Semantic Perception team, which develops novel core technology around computer vision and ML, with a particular focus on scene and object understanding and 3D computer vision. You will work across the full range from research to product, as part of a team composed of Research Scientists and Software Engineers, serving multiple perception-related products at Google, with a particular focus on XR products and applications.

### Responsibilities

* Develop innovative computer vision and machine learning technology focused on 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, and novel view synthesis for XR applications.
* Drive the research, development, and optimization of 3D scene representation pipelines (such as Gaussian Splatting and Neural Representations), including improving model efficiency, training stability, and visual fidelity for large-scale scenes.
* Establish and maintain relationships with main stakeholders and keep recurring updates on the advancements of the project, making sure that their expectations are aligned to the research and engineering work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Google Zürich, Svizzera

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.
* 5 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo del software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione.
* 3 anni di esperienza con Computer Vision (classificazione dell'immagine e elaborazione, rilevamento degli oggetti, ricerca visiva), generazione video o elaborazione del segnale; e progettazione di sistemi Computer Vision.
* 3 anni di esperienza con l'infrastruttura ML (ad esempio, distribuzione dei modelli, valutazione dei modelli, elaborazione dei dati, debug).
* Record di pubblicazione in conferenze AI (ad esempio, NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR).

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campo tecnico correlato.
* Esperienza di lavoro in un laboratorio di ricerca industriale o accademico, concentrandosi su molteplici aspetti della pipeline "ricerca al prodotto", in particolare l'ottimizzazione del modello e i miglioramenti dell'efficienza.
* Familiarità con tecniche di AI generative, come i modelli di diffusione delle immagini, e la loro applicazione al miglioramento visivo.
* Forte sfondo nella visione del computer 3D e nell'apprendimento profondo, con competenze specifiche e collaudate in Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), e ricostruzione della scena 3D.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e la memorizzazione dei dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. In qualità di ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

In questo ruolo, sarete parte del team di XR Semantic Perception, che sviluppa una nuova tecnologia di base intorno alla visione del computer e ML, con un particolare focus sulla scena e la comprensione degli oggetti e la visione del computer 3D. Potrai lavorare in tutta la gamma dalla ricerca al prodotto, come parte di un team composto da ricercatori e ingegneri di software, che serve più prodotti percettivi su Google, con una particolare attenzione ai prodotti e applicazioni XR.

### responsabilità

* Sviluppare una visione computerizzata innovativa e una tecnologia di machine learning focalizzata sulla ricostruzione 3D, la stima delle posizioni e la sintesi di visualizzazione nuova per le applicazioni XR.
* Guidare la ricerca, lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione delle pipeline di rappresentazione della scena 3D (come le rappresentazioni Gaussian Splatting e Neural), tra cui migliorare l'efficienza del modello, la stabilità della formazione e la fedeltà visiva per le scene su larga scala.
* Stabilire e mantenere le relazioni con i principali stakeholder e mantenere aggiornamenti ricorrenti sui progressi del progetto, assicurandosi che le loro aspettative siano allineate al lavoro di ricerca e ingegneria.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Google Zürich, Schweiz

### Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
* 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen.
* 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Computer Vision (Bildklassifizierung und -verarbeitung, Objekterkennung, visuelle Suche), Videogenerierung oder Signalverarbeitung und Erfahrung beim Entwerfen von Computer Vision-Systemen.
* 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit ML-Infrastruktur (z. B. Modellbereitstellung, Modellbewertung, Datenverarbeitung, Debugging).
* Veröffentlichungsprotokoll in KI-Konferenzen (z. B. NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR).

### Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereich.
* Erfahrung in einem Industrie- oder akademischen Forschungslabor, das sich auf mehrere Aspekte der "Research to Product" -Pipeline konzentriert, insbesondere auf Modelloptimierung und Effizienzverbesserungen.
* Vertrautheit mit generativen KI-Techniken wie Bilddiffusionsmodellen und deren Anwendung zur visuellen Verbesserung.
* Starker Hintergrund in 3D-Computer Vision und Deep Learning mit spezifischer, nachgewiesener Expertise in Gaußian Splatting (3DGS), neuronalen Strahlungsfeldern (NeRF) und 3D-Szenenrekonstruktion.

### Über den Job

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie Milliarden von Nutzern Informationen miteinander verbinden, erforschen und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobilgeräte; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und enthusiastisch zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie Teil des XR Semantic Perception-Teams sein, das neuartige Kerntechnologien rund um Computer Vision und ML entwickelt, mit besonderem Fokus auf Szenen- und Objektverständnis und 3D-Computer Vision. Sie werden über das gesamte Spektrum von der Forschung bis zum Produkt arbeiten, als Teil eines Teams aus Forschern und Software-Ingenieuren, die mehrere Wahrnehmungs-bezogene Produkte bei Google, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf XR-Produkte und Anwendungen.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Entwicklung innovativer Computer Vision- und Machine Learning-Technologien, die sich auf 3D-Rekonstruktion, Posenschätzung und neuartige Ansichtssynthese für XR-Anwendungen konzentrieren.
* Fahren Sie die Erforschung, Entwicklung und Optimierung von 3D-Szenendarstellungspipelines (wie Gaußian Splatting und Neural Representations), einschließlich der Verbesserung der Modelleffizienz, der Trainingsstabilität und der visuellen Treue für großformatige Szenen.
* Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu den wichtigsten Interessengruppen und regelmäßige Aktualisierungen der Fortschritte des Projekts, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Erwartungen an die Forschungs- und Ingenieurarbeit ausgerichtet sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Google Zürich, Suisse

### Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.
* 5 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation.
* 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la vision informatique (classification et traitement de l'image, détection d'objets, recherche visuelle), production vidéo ou traitement de signaux; et expérience de la conception de systèmes de vision informatique.
* 3 ans d'expérience avec l'infrastructure ML (p. ex. déploiement de modèles, évaluation de modèles, traitement des données, débogage).
* Dossier de publication dans les conférences sur l'IA (p. ex., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR).

### Titres préférés:

* Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou domaine technique connexe.
* Expérience de travail dans un laboratoire de recherche industriel ou universitaire, en mettant l'accent sur de multiples aspects du pipeline de la recherche sur les produits, en particulier l'optimisation des modèles et les améliorations de l'efficacité.
* Connaissance des techniques génériques d'IA, telles que les modèles de diffusion d'images, et leur application à l'amélioration visuelle.
* Forte expérience dans la vision informatique 3D et l'apprentissage profond, avec une expertise spécifique et éprouvée dans l'installation gaussienne (3DGS), les champs de rayonnement neuronal (NeRF) et la reconstruction des scènes 3D.

### Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et l'autre. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la récupération d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur en logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour les besoins de Google.Vous aurez l'occasion de changer d'équipes et de projets au fur et à mesure que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide grandirez et évoluerez. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes dans l'ensemble de la pile alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Dans ce rôle, vous ferez partie de l'équipe de perception sémantique XR, qui développe une nouvelle technologie de base autour de la vision informatique et du ML, avec un accent particulier sur la compréhension de la scène et des objets et la vision informatique 3D. Vous travaillerez dans toute la gamme, de la recherche au produit, dans le cadre d'une équipe composée de chercheurs scientifiques et d'ingénieurs logiciels, servant plusieurs produits liés à la perception chez Google, avec un accent particulier sur les produits et les applications XR.

### Responsabilités

* Développer une vision informatique innovante et une technologie d'apprentissage automatique axée sur la reconstruction 3D, l'estimation des poses et la synthèse de vues nouvelles pour les applications XR.
* Diriger la recherche, le développement et l'optimisation des pipelines de représentation des scènes 3D (comme le spot gaussien et les représentations neurales), y compris l'amélioration de l'efficacité des modèles, la stabilité de l'entraînement et la fidélité visuelle pour les scènes à grande échelle.
* Établir et maintenir des relations avec les principaux intervenants et tenir à jour régulièrement les progrès du projet, en veillant à ce que leurs attentes soient alignées sur les travaux de recherche et d'ingénierie.

jobs.description:
Google Zürich, Switzerland

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 2 years of experience building software for data privacy or security (e.g., identity and access management).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
* 2 years experience of working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Experience building security tooling.
* Experience in static analysis or dynamic analysis.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, with your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

### Responsibilities

* Write product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und enthusiastisch zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle verwalten Sie mit Ihrem technischen Fachwissen Projektprioritäten, Termine und Ergebnisse. Sie entwerfen, entwickeln, testen, implementieren, warten und verbessern Softwarelösungen.

Google Cloud beschleunigt die Fähigkeit jedes Unternehmens, sein Geschäft und seine Branche digital zu verändern. Wir liefern Lösungen für Unternehmen, die die modernste Technologie von Google nutzen, und Tools, die Entwicklern helfen, nachhaltiger zu bauen. Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen wenden sich an Google Cloud als ihren vertrauenswürdigen Partner, um Wachstum zu ermöglichen und ihre wichtigsten Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Schreiben Sie Produkt- oder Systementwicklungscode.
* Beteiligen Sie sich an oder leiten Sie Design Reviews mit Peers und Stakeholdern, um zwischen den verfügbaren Technologien zu entscheiden.
* Überprüfen Sie den von anderen Entwicklern entwickelten Code und geben Sie Feedback, um Best Practices sicherzustellen (z. B. Stilrichtlinien, Überprüfung des Codes, Genauigkeit, Testbarkeit und Effizienz).
* Tragen Sie zu vorhandenen Dokumentationen oder Bildungsinhalten bei und passen Sie die Inhalte auf der Grundlage von Produkt- / Programmaktualisierungen und Benutzerfeedback an.
* Triage Produkt- oder Systemprobleme und Debug/Track/Resolve durch Analyse der Ursachen von Problemen und der Auswirkungen auf Hardware, Netzwerk- oder Servicebetrieb und Qualität.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Google Zürich, Suisse

### Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.
* 2 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation, ou 1 an d'expérience avec un diplôme avancé.
* 2 ans d'expérience dans la création de logiciels pour la protection des données ou la sécurité (p. ex. gestion de l'identité et de l'accès).

### Titres préférés:

* Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou domaines techniques connexes.
* 2 ans d'expérience de travail dans une organisation complexe et matricielle impliquant des projets interfonctionnels ou interentreprises.
* 2 ans d'expérience dans les structures de données et les algorithmes.
* Expérience du développement de technologies accessibles.
* Expérience de l'outillage de sécurité de construction.
* Expérience en analyse statique ou en analyse dynamique.

### Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et l'autre. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la récupération d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur en logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour les besoins de Google.Vous aurez l'occasion de changer d'équipes et de projets au fur et à mesure que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide grandirez et évoluerez. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes dans l'ensemble de la pile alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Dans ce rôle, grâce à votre expertise technique, vous gérerez les priorités du projet, les échéances et les livrables. Vous allez concevoir, développer, tester, déployer, maintenir et améliorer des solutions logicielles.

Google Cloud accélère la capacité de chaque organisation à transformer numériquement ses activités et son industrie. Nous fournissons des solutions de qualité entreprise qui tirent parti de la technologie de pointe de Google, et des outils qui aident les développeurs à construire plus durablement. Les clients de plus de 200 pays et territoires se tournent vers Google Cloud en tant que partenaire de confiance pour favoriser la croissance et résoudre leurs problèmes commerciaux les plus critiques.

### Responsabilités

* Écrivez le code de développement du produit ou du système.
* Participer ou diriger des examens de conception avec des pairs et des intervenants pour décider entre les technologies disponibles.
* Examiner le code élaboré par d'autres développeurs et fournir des commentaires pour assurer les meilleures pratiques (p. ex., lignes directrices sur le style, code de vérification, précision, testabilité et efficacité).
* Contribuer à la documentation ou au contenu éducatif existants et adapter le contenu en fonction des mises à jour des produits/programmes et de la rétroaction des utilisateurs.
* Trier les problèmes de produit ou de système et déboguer, suivre ou résoudre en analysant les sources de problèmes et l'impact sur le matériel, le réseau ou les opérations de service et la qualité.

jobs.description:
Google Zürich, Switzerland

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

* 5 years of experience in program management.

* Experience with software development lifecycles and related tools such as bug trackers, software repositories, and code testing frameworks.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Experience in driving organizational change, including the development of new frameworks, processes, and standards for security engineering.
* Experience in evaluating the security posture of AI/ML systems, including Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and threat modeling for AI applications.
* Experience building dashboards and utilizing data-driven insights to measure security efficacy.
* Ability to understand engineering fundamentals and system architecture.
* Exceptional communication skills including experience communicating with executive stakeholders at director or VP level.

### About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

### Responsibilities

* Lead the end-to-end execution of large-scale, complex security programs, influencing strategy and driving high-impact results across multiple quarters.

* Negotiate and align priorities with executive stakeholders across engineering, product, and research, resolving conflicting goals and driving organizational consensus.
* Partner with technical leads to translate high-level security objectives into actionable technical roadmaps and project plans. Regularly communicate program status, risks, and impact to stakeholders and leadership, fostering transparency and trust.
* Monitor program health using data-driven metrics, proactively identifying roadblocks, and driving resolution to ensure adherence to milestones and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)/Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Identify opportunities to streamline engineering workflows, automate manual tasks, and improve overall operational efficiency.

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea in un campo tecnico, o equivalente esperienza pratica.

* 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei programmi.

* Esperienza con programmi di sviluppo software e strumenti correlati come bug tracker, repository software e framework di test di codice.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Esperienza nella guida del cambiamento organizzativo, tra cui lo sviluppo di nuovi quadri, processi e standard per l'ingegneria della sicurezza.
* Esperienza nella valutazione della postura di sicurezza dei sistemi AI/ML, compresi i modelli di lingua grande (LLM), i flussi di lavoro agentici e la modellazione delle minacce per le applicazioni AI.
* Sperimenta i cruscotti per la costruzione e utilizza intuizioni basate sui dati per misurare l'efficacia della sicurezza.
* Capacità di comprendere i fondamenti di ingegneria e l'architettura di sistema.
* Capacità di comunicazione eccezionali, tra cui l'esperienza di comunicare con gli stakeholders esecutivi a livello di direttore o VP.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Un problema non è veramente risolto fino a quando non è risolto per tutti. Ecco perché Googlers costruisce prodotti che aiutano a creare opportunità per tutti, sia lungo la strada o in tutto il mondo. In qualità di Technical Program Manager di Google, userai la tua esperienza tecnica per condurre progetti complessi e multidisciplinari dall'inizio alla fine. Potrai lavorare con le parti interessate per pianificare i requisiti, identificare i rischi, gestire i programmi di progetto e comunicare con i partner interfunzionali in tutta l'azienda. Sei altrettanto comodo spiegare le analisi e le raccomandazioni del tuo team ai dirigenti mentre stai discutendo dei tradeoff tecnici nello sviluppo dei prodotti con gli ingegneri.

### responsabilità

* Condurre l'esecuzione end-to-end di programmi di sicurezza complessi su larga scala, influenzando la strategia e guidando risultati ad alto impatto su più quarti.

* Negoziare e allineare le priorità con le parti interessate esecutive in materia di ingegneria, prodotto e ricerca, risolvere obiettivi contrastanti e guidare il consenso organizzativo.
* Partner tecnico porta a tradurre obiettivi di sicurezza di alto livello in roadmap tecniche attuabili e piani di progetto. Comunica regolarmente lo stato del programma, i rischi e l'impatto alle parti interessate e alla leadership, favorendo la trasparenza e la fiducia.
* Monitorare la salute del programma utilizzando metriche data-driven, identificare proattivamente i blocchi stradali, e la risoluzione di guida per garantire l'adesione a pietre miliari e accordi di livello di servizio (SLA) / obiettivi di livello di servizio (SLO).
* Identificare le opportunità per semplificare i flussi di lavoro di ingegneria, automatizzare le attività manuali e migliorare l'efficienza operativa complessiva.

jobs.description:
Google Zürich, Switzerland

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* 8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
* Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch, and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform).
* Experience leading technical discovery sessions with customers.
* Ability to communicate in French or German fluently as this is a customer-facing role that requires interactions in French or German with local stakeholders.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).

* Experience in a post-sales or technical consulting delivery function.
* Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

### About the job

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in the Google Cloud Consulting organization, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

### Responsibilities

* Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).

* Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.

* Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

* Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

* Co-build with pre-sales and product teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

E 'un momento emozionante per unire il team Go-To-Market di Google Cloud, leader la rivoluzione AI per le imprese in tutto il mondo. jobs.description:
YouTube Zürich, Switzerland

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in an applied research setting, or similar.
* 3 years of experience leading design projects and managing people or teams.

* Experience managing a UXR team in a product environment.
* Experience working with data science, marketing and strategy to triangulate behavioral data with user insights.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or a related field.
* 7 years of experience working with executive leadership (e.g., Director level and above).

* 5 years of experience managing projects, and working in a large, matrixed organization.

* Excellent executive communication skills, with a proven track record of presenting to and influencing Director and VP-level stakeholders.

### About the job

At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a UX Research Manager, you will help define and drive the future of Google design by clarifying strategy and conceptualizing UX ecosystems. You are an expert researcher, a visionary leader, and a fierce advocate for both users and your team.

You will be responsible for guiding the careers of your team members, helping them realize their full potential, and inspiring forward-thinking design. You are an expert in qualitative research methods—such as field studies, interviews, and diary studies—to shape product development and influence overall strategy. In this role, you will understand both the execution and business aspects of our products, collaborating with leaders across UX, Engineering, and Product Management to create innovative experiences, leveraging your passion for brand, craft, and design quality.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

### Responsibilities

* Manage, coach, and mentor a team of UX Researchers (UXR) working on Creator and Viewer. Foster a collaborative and high-performing team culture. Guide career development, manage resource allocation, and ensure research excellence.
* Define and drive the holistic UXR roadmap for YouTube Shopping’s Viewer and Creator experiences, aligning research goals with key business Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).
* Lead foundational, and research initiatives in the Creator space.Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Design leads to influence product strategy, define key user frameworks, and establish user-centered metrics.
* Synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative data into compelling, actionable narratives. Present insights and recommendations to executive leadership (Director and VP/GM levels) to drive alignment and decision-making.

### Riguardo al lavoro

A Google, "Focus sull'utente e tutto il resto seguirà". Come UX Research Manager, ti aiuterà a definire e guidare il futuro del design di Google chiarificando strategia e concettualizzare gli ecosistemi UX. Sei un ricercatore esperto, un leader visionario, e un feroce sostenitore sia per gli utenti che per il vostro team.

Sarete responsabili di guidare le carriere dei membri del vostro team, aiutandoli a realizzare il loro pieno potenziale, e ispirando design in avanti. Sei un esperto di metodi di ricerca qualitativi, come studi sul campo, interviste e studi diario, per modellare lo sviluppo del prodotto e influenzare la strategia generale. In questo ruolo, comprenderete sia l'esecuzione che gli aspetti aziendali dei nostri prodotti, collaborando con i leader di UX, Engineering e Product Management per creare esperienze innovative, sfruttando la vostra passione per il brand, l'artigianato e la qualità del design.

Su YouTube, crediamo che tutti meritino di avere una voce, e che il mondo è un posto migliore quando ascoltiamo, condividiamo e costruiamo la comunità attraverso le nostre storie. Lavoriamo insieme per dare a tutti il potere di condividere la loro storia, esplorare ciò che amano, e connettersi tra loro nel processo. Lavorando all'incrocio tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività senza limiti, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo comune per mostrare alle persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e divertiamo — e lo facciamo tutti insieme.

### responsabilità

* Gestire, coach e mentore un team di ricercatori UX (UXR) che lavorano su Creator e Viewer. Promuovere una cultura collaborativa e di alto livello. Guida lo sviluppo della carriera, gestire l'allocazione delle risorse e garantire l'eccellenza della ricerca.
* Definire e guidare la roadmap olistica UXR per le esperienze di YouTube Shopping Viewer e Creator, allineando gli obiettivi di ricerca con obiettivi aziendali chiave e risultati chiave (OKRs).
* Guidare iniziative di base e di ricerca nello spazio Creatore. Partner con Product Management, Engineering e Design porta ad influenzare la strategia del prodotto, definire i framework utente chiave e stabilire metriche centrate sull'utente.
* Synthesize complessi dati qualitativi e quantitativi in narrazioni convincenti e attuabili. Presenta intuizioni e raccomandazioni alla leadership esecutiva (livello Direttore e VP/GM) per guidare l'allineamento e il processo decisionale.

* 8 ans d'expérience dans un cadre de recherche appliquée, ou similaire.
* 3 ans d'expérience à la tête de projets de conception et de gestion de personnes ou d'équipes.

* Expérience de gestion d'une équipe UXR dans un environnement produit.
* Expérience de travail avec la science des données, le marketing et la stratégie pour trianguler les données comportementales avec des informations utilisateur.

### Titres préférés:

* Maîtrise ou doctorat en interaction homme-informatique, science cognitive, statistique, psychologie, anthropologie ou domaine connexe.
* 7 années d'expérience avec le leadership exécutif (p. ex., niveau directeur et niveau supérieur).

* 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de projets et dans une grande organisation matricielle.

* Excellentes compétences en communication avec les cadres supérieurs, avec une expérience éprouvée de présentation et d'influence auprès des intervenants de niveau directeur et vice-président.

### Sur le travail

Chez Google, nous "Focus sur l'utilisateur et tout le reste suivra." En tant que responsable de recherche UX, vous aiderez à définir et à piloter l'avenir de la conception Google en clarifiant la stratégie et en conceptualisant les écosystèmes UX. Vous êtes un chercheur expert, un leader visionnaire et un ardent défenseur des utilisateurs et de votre équipe.

Vous serez responsable de guider les carrières des membres de votre équipe, de les aider à réaliser leur plein potentiel et d'inspirer la conception avant-gardiste. Vous êtes un expert en méthodes de recherche qualitatives – comme les études sur le terrain, les entrevues et les études de journal – pour façonner le développement de produits et influencer la stratégie globale. Dans ce rôle, vous comprendrez à la fois les aspects d'exécution et d'affaires de nos produits, en collaborant avec des leaders dans les domaines de l'UX, de l'ingénierie et de la gestion des produits pour créer des expériences innovantes, en tirant parti de votre passion pour la marque, l'artisanat et la qualité de conception.

Sur YouTube, nous croyons que tout le monde mérite d'avoir une voix, et que le monde est un meilleur endroit quand nous écoutons, partageons et construisons la communauté à travers nos histoires. Nous travaillons ensemble pour donner à chacun le pouvoir de partager son histoire, d'explorer ce qu'il aime et de se connecter dans le processus. Travaillant à l'intersection d'une technologie de pointe et d'une créativité illimitée, nous agissons à la vitesse de la culture avec un objectif commun de montrer aux gens le monde. Nous explorons de nouvelles idées, résolvons de vrais problèmes et nous nous amusons — et nous le faisons tous ensemble.

### Responsabilités

* Gérer, coacher et encadrer une équipe de chercheurs UX (UXR) travaillant sur Creator and Viewer. Favoriser une culture d'équipe collaborative et performante. Guider le perfectionnement professionnel, gérer l'affectation des ressources et assurer l'excellence en recherche.
* Définir et piloter la feuille de route globale UXR pour le shopping YouTube Expériences de visionneur et de créateur, en alignant les objectifs de recherche avec les principaux objectifs et résultats clés (OKR).
* Diriger les initiatives fondamentales et de recherche dans l'espace Créateur. Le partenariat avec la gestion des produits, l'ingénierie et la conception conduit à influencer la stratégie des produits, à définir les principaux cadres d'utilisation et à établir des paramètres axés sur l'utilisateur.
* Synthétiser des données qualitatives et quantitatives complexes en récits convaincants et exploitables. Présenter des idées et des recommandations aux dirigeants (directeurs et vice-présidents/GM) afin de favoriser l'harmonisation et la prise de décisions.

jobs.description:
Google Zürich, Switzerland

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

* 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.

* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

### Responsibilities

* Write product or system development code.

* Collaborate with peers and stakeholders through design and code reviews to ensure best practices amongst available technologies (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product or program updates and user feedback.

* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

* Implement solutions in one or more specialized Machine Learning (ML) areas, utilize ML infrastructure, and contribute to model optimization and data processing.

Google Zürich, Svizzera

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

* 2 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione, o 1 anno di esperienza con un grado avanzato.

* 1 anno di esperienza con uno o più dei seguenti: Speech/audio (ad esempio, la tecnologia che duplica e risponde alla voce umana), l'apprendimento di rinforzo (ad esempio, il processo decisionale sequenziale), l'infrastruttura ML o la specializzazione in un altro campo ML.

* 1 anno di esperienza con l'infrastruttura ML (ad esempio, distribuzione del modello, valutazione del modello, ottimizzazione, elaborazione dei dati, debugging).

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o campi tecnici correlati.

* 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.
* Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e la memorizzazione dei dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. In qualità di ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia. Google Cloud accelera la capacità di ogni organizzazione di trasformare digitalmente il suo business e l'industria. Offriamo soluzioni di livello enterprise che sfruttano la tecnologia all'avanguardia di Google e gli strumenti che aiutano gli sviluppatori a costruire in modo più sostenibile. I clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori si rivolgono a Google Cloud come partner affidabile per consentire la crescita e risolvere i loro problemi aziendali più critici.

### responsabilità

* Scrivere il codice di sviluppo del prodotto o del sistema.

* Collaborare con colleghi e stakeholder attraverso recensioni di design e codice per garantire le migliori pratiche tra le tecnologie disponibili (ad esempio, linee guida di stile, controllo del codice, accuratezza, testabilità e efficienza).

* Contribuisci alla documentazione esistente o ai contenuti educativi e adatta i contenuti in base agli aggiornamenti di prodotto o programma e al feedback degli utenti.

* Triage prodotto o problemi di sistema e debug/track/resolve analizzando le fonti di problemi e l'impatto su hardware, rete, o operazioni di servizio e qualità.

* Soluzioni di implementazione in uno o più settori specializzati Machine Learning (ML), utilizzare l'infrastruttura ML e contribuire a modellare l'ottimizzazione e l'elaborazione dei dati.

### Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

* 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen oder 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einem fortgeschrittenen Abschluss.

* 1 Jahr Erfahrung mit einem oder mehreren der folgenden Themen: Sprache / Audio (z. B. Technologie, die die menschliche Stimme dupliziert und darauf reagiert), Verstärkungslernen (z. B. sequentielle Entscheidungsfindung), ML-Infrastruktur oder Spezialisierung in einem anderen ML-Bereich.

* Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereichen.

* 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen.
* Erfahrung in der Entwicklung zugänglicher Technologien.

### Über den Job

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie Milliarden von Nutzern Informationen miteinander verbinden, erforschen und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobilgeräte; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und enthusiastisch zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben. Google Cloud beschleunigt die Fähigkeit jedes Unternehmens, sein Geschäft und seine Branche digital zu verändern. Wir liefern Lösungen für Unternehmen, die die modernste Technologie von Google nutzen, und Tools, die Entwicklern helfen, nachhaltiger zu bauen. Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen wenden sich an Google Cloud als ihren vertrauenswürdigen Partner, um Wachstum zu ermöglichen und ihre wichtigsten Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Schreiben Sie Produkt- oder Systementwicklungscode.

* Arbeiten Sie mit Peers und Stakeholdern durch Design- und Code-Reviews zusammen, um Best Practices unter den verfügbaren Technologien sicherzustellen (z. B. Stilrichtlinien, Überprüfung des Codes, Genauigkeit, Testbarkeit und Effizienz).

* Tragen Sie zu vorhandenen Dokumentations- oder Bildungsinhalten bei und passen Sie Inhalte basierend auf Produkt- oder Programmupdates und Benutzerfeedback an.

* Triage Produkt- oder Systemprobleme und Debug/Track/Resolve durch Analyse der Ursachen von Problemen und der Auswirkungen auf Hardware, Netzwerk- oder Servicebetrieb und Qualität.

* Implementieren Sie Lösungen in einem oder mehreren spezialisierten ML-Bereichen, nutzen Sie die ML-Infrastruktur und tragen Sie zur Modelloptimierung und Datenverarbeitung bei.

Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes dans l'ensemble de la pile alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie. * Mettre en œuvre des solutions dans un ou plusieurs domaines spécialisés de l'apprentissage automatique, utiliser l'infrastructure ML et contribuer à l'optimisation des modèles et au traitement des données.

jobs.description:
Google Zürich, Switzerland; New York, NY, USA

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Zürich, Switzerland; New York, NY, USA.

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a technical security role (e.g., security engineering, security research, DevSecOps, or incident response).
* Experience with vulnerability assessments and vulnerability exploitation.
* Experience in security and ethical hacking.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 3 years of offensive security experience (red teaming, vulnerability research, pen testing, etc - not just running tools) in Cloud environment.
* Experience with Artificial Intelligence.
* Ability to develop custom exploits, modify existing exploits, and bypass security controls.
* Fluency in programming languages relevant to security and cloud automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash).
* Being able to clearly and concisely articulate complex technical findings, risks, and remediation strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.

### About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

As a part of the Product Security Engineering team within the Cloud CISO organization, you will be responsible for helping ensure every product in Cloud is as secure as it can be, and increasing the security in the infrastructure underlying all our products.

As a part of the Cloud Red Team, your mission is to evaluate our ability to detect and respond to known and unknown threats by simulating real-world adversaries that aim to compromise and persist in Cloud’s infrastructure. In short: Hack Cloud to make hacking Cloud harder.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $253000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

### Responsibilities

* Define and maintain the roadmap for one of the programs within Cloud Red Team, while collaborating within a highly-skilled team to plan and execute attacks against Cloud’s products, services, and infrastructure.
* Build tools and infrastructure to support attacker goals, while identifying vulnerabilities and attack vectors across Cloud services, configurations, and related technologies.
* Participate in threat modeling exercises to identify potential attack paths and weaknesses in Cloud architectures and deployments.
* Design realistic and relevant attack scenarios based on current threat intelligence and the specific Cloud environment being assessed.
* Create reports that capture the insights gained during an attack and present them to a variety of audiences.

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.
* 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di sicurezza tecnica (ad esempio, ingegneria della sicurezza, ricerca di sicurezza, DevSecOps, o risposta di incidente).
* Esperienza con le valutazioni della vulnerabilità e lo sfruttamento della vulnerabilità.
* Esperienza nella sicurezza e hacking etico.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* 3 anni di esperienza di sicurezza offensiva (red teaming, ricerca di vulnerabilità, test di penna, ecc - non solo eseguire strumenti) in ambiente Cloud.
* Esperienza con intelligenza artificiale.
* Capacità di sviluppare exploit personalizzati, modificare gli exploit esistenti e bypassare i controlli di sicurezza.
* Fluency in linguaggi di programmazione rilevanti per la sicurezza e l'automazione cloud (ad esempio, Python, Go, Bash).
* Essere in grado di articolare chiaramente e concisamente complesse scoperte tecniche, rischi e strategie di bonifica sia a livello tecnico che non tecnico, sia verbalmente che per iscritto.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Il nostro team di sicurezza lavora per creare e mantenere l'ambiente operativo più sicuro per gli utenti e gli sviluppatori di Google. Gli ingegneri di sicurezza lavorano con apparecchiature di rete e monitorano attivamente i nostri sistemi per attacchi e intrusioni. In questo ruolo, lavorerai anche con gli ingegneri del software per identificare proattivamente e correggere i difetti di sicurezza e le vulnerabilità.

Come parte del team di Product Security Engineering all'interno dell'organizzazione Cloud CISO, sarete responsabili di aiutare a garantire che ogni prodotto in Cloud sia sicuro come può essere, e aumentare la sicurezza nell'infrastruttura sottostante tutti i nostri prodotti.

Come parte del Cloud Red Team, la vostra missione è quella di valutare la nostra capacità di rilevare e rispondere a minacce note e sconosciute simulando avversari del mondo reale che mirano a compromettere e persistono nell’infrastruttura di Cloud. In breve: Hack Cloud per rendere più difficile l'hacking Cloud.

La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori, tra cui competenze, esperienze, istruzione o formazione rilevanti.

US: $174000 - $253000 (USD) + 15% target bonus + equity + benefici

Ulteriori informazioni sui benefici a Google.

### responsabilità

* Definire e mantenere la roadmap per uno dei programmi all’interno del Cloud Red Team, collaborando all’interno di un team altamente qualificato per pianificare ed eseguire attacchi contro i prodotti, i servizi e le infrastrutture di Cloud.
* Costruire strumenti e infrastrutture per supportare gli obiettivi degli attaccanti, identificando le vulnerabilità e i vettori di attacco attraverso i servizi Cloud, le configurazioni e le tecnologie correlate.
* Partecipa ad esercizi di modellazione delle minacce per identificare potenziali percorsi di attacco e debolezze nelle architetture e nelle implementazioni Cloud.
* Progettare scenari di attacco realistici e rilevanti basati sull'attuale intelligenza delle minacce e sull'ambiente cloud specifico in fase di valutazione.
* Crea report che catturano le intuizioni acquisite durante un attacco e li presentano a una varietà di pubblico.
descriptionByLocale.de:

### Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

Unser Sicherheitsteam arbeitet daran, die sicherste Betriebsumgebung für Benutzer und Entwickler von Google zu schaffen und zu pflegen. Security Engineers arbeiten mit Netzwerkausrüstung und überwachen unsere Systeme aktiv auf Angriffe und Eindringlinge. Als Teil des Product Security Engineering-Teams innerhalb der Cloud CISO-Organisation sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, sicherzustellen, dass jedes Produkt in der Cloud so sicher wie möglich ist und die Sicherheit in der Infrastruktur, die allen unseren Produkten zugrunde liegt, erhöht wird.

Als Teil des Cloud Red Teams ist es Ihre Aufgabe, unsere Fähigkeit zu bewerten, bekannte und unbekannte Bedrohungen zu erkennen und darauf zu reagieren, indem Sie reale Gegner simulieren, die darauf abzielen, die Cloud-Infrastruktur zu kompromittieren und aufrechtzuerhalten. Kurz gesagt: Hack Cloud, um das Hacken der Cloud zu erschweren.

Die individuelle Bezahlung wird durch Faktoren wie berufsbezogene Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und relevante Aus- oder Weiterbildung bestimmt.

US: $174000 - $253000 (USD) + 15% Bonusziel + Eigenkapital + Vorteile

* Erstellen Sie Tools und Infrastrukturen, um Angreiferziele zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig Schwachstellen und Angriffsvektoren für Cloud-Dienste, Konfigurationen und verwandte Technologien zu identifizieren.

jobs.description:
Google Zürich, Switzerland

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in software development.
* 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
* 5 years of experience with software design and architecture.
* 5 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.

### Preferred qualifications:

* 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.
* Experience in static analysis or dynamic analysis.
* Consulting experience.
* Experience building security tooling.
* Ability to influence others.
* Strong communication skills.

### About the job

Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering team is responsible for ensuring that every Google Cloud product ships as secure as possible. You will do so by increasing the assurance levels of security in the infrastructure underlying all products, increasing the capabilities of each product team to develop more secure products by design and by default, from patterns, tools, and frameworks to increasing the skill level of embedded security leads. Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering owns and drives the product security strategy for Google Cloud. You will work with almost every aspect of Google’s infrastructure and on solving planet-scale infrastructure security problems that have societal-level impacts.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

### Responsibilities

* Perform security reviews, research and reproduce vulnerabilities, design secure protocols and systems, and write tests and fuzzers.
* Review and develop secure operational practices, and provide security guidance for engineers and support staff.
* Review designs and drive towards defense in depth and security by default, both with one-time reviews and longer term engagements.
* Look for vulnerabilities with techniques including reverse engineering, fuzzing, and static analysis.
* Respond to vulnerabilities with repros, variant analysis, mitigations, and hardening.

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.
* 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del software.
* 5 anni di test di esperienza e lancio di prodotti software.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* 3 anni di esperienza che lavorano in un complesso, matrice organizzazione che coinvolge progetti interfunzionali o cross-business.
* Esperienza nell'analisi statica o nell'analisi dinamica.
* Esperienza di consulenza.
* Esperienza costruzione strumenti di sicurezza.
* Capacità di influenzare gli altri.
* Forte capacità di comunicazione.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Gli ingegneri software di Google Cloud sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e la memorizzazione dei dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico alle esigenze di Google Cloud con le opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescono ed evolvono. Prevedrai le nostre esigenze dei clienti e sarai in grado di agire come un proprietario, agire e innovare. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Il team di Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering è responsabile per garantire che ogni prodotto di Google Cloud navi il più sicuro possibile. Lo farai aumentando i livelli di sicurezza nell'infrastruttura sottostante tutti i prodotti, aumentando le capacità di ogni team di prodotti per sviluppare prodotti più sicuri per design e per impostazione predefinita, dai modelli, strumenti e framework per aumentare il livello di abilità dei cavi di sicurezza incorporati. Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering possiede e guida la strategia di sicurezza dei prodotti per Google Cloud. Potrai lavorare con quasi tutti gli aspetti dell'infrastruttura di Google e sulla soluzione di problemi di sicurezza delle infrastrutture su scala planetaria che hanno impatti a livello sociale.

Google Cloud accelera la capacità di ogni organizzazione di trasformare digitalmente il suo business e l'industria. Offriamo soluzioni di livello enterprise che sfruttano la tecnologia all'avanguardia di Google e gli strumenti che aiutano gli sviluppatori a costruire in modo più sostenibile. I clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori si rivolgono a Google Cloud come partner affidabile per consentire la crescita e risolvere i loro problemi aziendali più critici.

### responsabilità

* Eseguire le recensioni di sicurezza, la ricerca e riprodurre le vulnerabilità, progettare protocolli e sistemi sicuri, e scrivere test e fuzzers.
* Verificare e sviluppare pratiche operative sicure e fornire una guida di sicurezza per gli ingegneri e il personale di supporto.
* I progetti di revisione e l'azionamento verso la difesa in profondità e sicurezza per impostazione predefinita, sia con recensioni una volta e impegni a lungo termine.
* Cerca vulnerabilità con tecniche tra cui reverse engineering, fuzzing e analisi statica.
* Risponde alle vulnerabilità con repro, analisi delle varianti, mitigazioni e indurimento.

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google Cloud entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google Cloud von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Sie werden unsere Kundenbedürfnisse antizipieren und in der Lage sein, wie ein Eigentümer zu handeln, Maßnahmen zu ergreifen und innovativ zu sein. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und enthusiastisch zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Das Team des Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering ist dafür verantwortlich, dass jedes Google Cloud-Produkt so sicher wie möglich ausgeliefert wird. Sie werden dies tun, indem Sie das Sicherheitsniveau in der Infrastruktur erhöhen, die allen Produkten zugrunde liegt, die Fähigkeiten jedes Produktteams erhöhen, um sicherere Produkte durch Design und Standard zu entwickeln, von Mustern, Tools und Frameworks bis hin zur Erhöhung des Qualifikationsniveaus von eingebetteten Sicherheitsleitern. Cloud Chief Information Security Office Security Engineering besitzt und steuert die Produktsicherheitsstrategie für Google Cloud. Sie arbeiten mit fast jedem Aspekt der Google-Infrastruktur und an der Lösung von Sicherheitsproblemen auf Planetenebene, die Auswirkungen auf die Gesellschaft haben.

Google Cloud beschleunigt die Fähigkeit jedes Unternehmens, sein Geschäft und seine Branche digital zu verändern. Wir liefern Lösungen für Unternehmen, die die modernste Technologie von Google nutzen, und Tools, die Entwicklern helfen, nachhaltiger zu bauen. Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen wenden sich an Google Cloud als ihren vertrauenswürdigen Partner, um Wachstum zu ermöglichen und ihre wichtigsten Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen.

jobs.description:
Google Zürich, Switzerland

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).
* 1 year of experience with Computer Vision (e.g., image classification and processing, object detection, visual search), video generation, or signal processing.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.
* Proficiency in code and system health, diagnosis and resolution, and software test engineering.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by

breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR

team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where

lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.

### Responsibilities

* Develop innovative computer vision and machine learning technology for applications in the field of spatial AI and context awareness.
* Productionalize innovative computer vision, deep learning and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the area of third-dimension (3D) scene understanding, including the design and implementation of such algorithms targeted at XR devices such as headsets and glasses.
* Lead the charge in developing and deploying Sensing across a range of XR products and use-cases.
* Collaborate strategically, directly interfacing with system owners to jointly define roadmaps for major XR perception endpoints.
* Scale our impact by developing robust systems and processes that ensure XR perception can support geometric and semantic sensing across a range of products and use cases
